name: Melissa Leoni
source:
"Personally, I'd prefer what you'd call a 'naked relationship.' What do you say?"

Likes: Being free, natto, any and all liquor, girls
Talent: Good with words & with her hands
Dislikes: Being held back, being bored
Favorite type of girl: Hard to get

Italian foreign exchange student, and [url=/c108879]Chris[/url]'s best friend. She is the daughter of a lower-class nobleman, and thus her behaviour is not especially "ladylike."

Although she looks mature and beautiful on the outside, she is actually quite lazy and opulent, marching to her own drummer. She is always in search of things that interest her, strongly disliking both being bored and being held back.

In addition, she likes cute girls (in a sexual manner as well). She has taken a great interest in new transfer student [url=/c108878]Rin[/url], and goes out of her way to try to get involved with him (again, sexually).
